newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms down 2.8pct y/y Sept.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms down 2.8pct y/y Sept.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 2.8 percent year-on-year in September, the national statistics institute Istat said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 76.1 (1988=100) in September, with month-on-month employment down 0.5 percent on August.
For the January-September period, employment fell 1.7 percent over the same nine-months in 1995.
Hours worked per employee fell 3.6 percent year-on-year, against a 5.4 percent fall in August, which Istat said was due to reduced overtime and less hours lost for industrial action.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes rose 14.1 percent year-on-year.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 90.9 (1992=100), a fall of 0.9 percent year-on-year and of 0.1 percent on August.
